title: Automation Lead
description:
The Automation Lead will be a key member of the Engineering Department and serve as the primary automation Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the sterile manufacturing facility. This role will be responsible for the design, implementation, commissioning, qualification, maintenance, and lifecycle management of automation and control systems supporting sterile manufacturing operations.

The primary scope of responsibility includes automation systems for sterile manufacturing equipment, Environmental Monitoring Systems (EMS), and automation of critical utility systems, including Water for Injection (WFI) generation and distribution, clean steam, compressed gases, and other applicable GMP utility systems. The Automation Lead will support the automation lifecycle from system design and vendor coordination through FAT, SAT, commissioning, qualification, start-up, routine operation, troubleshooting, cybersecurity, and continuous improvement.

This position is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.

Technical Oversight

• Serve as the primary automation SME for the sterile manufacturing facility, including automation and control systems for sterile manufacturing equipment, Environmental Monitoring Systems (EMS), and GMP utility systems.

• Provide technical and engineering support throughout the automation lifecycle, including automation architecture and design review, software and hardware design, FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning, start-up, and routine operation.

• Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of PLC, HMI, SCADA, DCS, Historian systems, industrial networks, data communication interfaces, control strategies, alarm management, and electronic data management applicable to assigned systems.

Technical Leadership

• Provide technical guidance and coaching to automation engineers and other technical staff.

• Foster strong cross-functional collaboration with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management teams.

• Establish a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, technical excellence, and proactive problem solving.

• Support resource planning and workload prioritization to meet business and project objectives.

Regulatory Compliance

• Ensure assigned automation systems and engineering activities are executed in compliance with cGMP requirements, applicable FDA requirements, EU GMP Annex 11, and internal quality standards.

• Partner with Quality, Validation, IT/OT, Engineering, and Manufacturing to maintain the validated state and ongoing compliance of assigned automation and computerized systems.

• Support development and execution of automation-related SOPs, technical procedures, and training.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail and clarity.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in automation or controls engineering within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.

• Hands-on experience with industrial automation systems, including PLC, HMI, SCADA, DCS, Historian systems, industrial communication networks, and control system troubleshooting.

• Experience with automation systems supporting pharmaceutical manufacturing equipment and GMP utility systems is strongly preferred.

• Experience with automation design, FAT, SAT, commissioning, qualification, start-up, and lifecycle management of GMP computerized systems.

• Deep understanding of cGMP requirements, risk-based approaches, data integrity principles, and global regulatory expectations for computerized systems.

• Strong knowledge of applicable regulatory and industry expectations, including FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, GAMP principles, cybersecurity, and electronic records management.

title: Engineer - Formulation
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and detail-oriented Formulation Engineer to join our Sterile Drug Product Engineering team.

The Formulation Engineer will be a key member of the Engineering Department and serve as the primary equipment Subject Matter Expert (SME) for sterile formulation and associated manufacturing equipment. This role will be responsible for providing technical and engineering support throughout the equipment lifecycle, including design review, vendor coordination, FAT/SAT, commissioning, qualification support, start-up, troubleshooting, and ongoing performance improvement.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with sterile formulation systems, CIP/SIP, and other pharmaceutical cleaning and sterilization systems. The Engineer will work closely with Manufacturing, Technical Services, Validation, Quality, and external equipment vendors to ensure equipment is designed, installed, qualified, and operated in a reliable and compliant manner.

This is an individual contributor position with no direct reports.

Technical Oversight

• Serve as the primary equipment SME for sterile formulation systems, including API and excipient weighing and dispensing, solution preparation, mixing, sterile filtration, bulk holding, transfer, and associated CIP/SIP systems.

• Provide engineering and technical support throughout the equipment lifecycle, including design review, FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning, start-up, and routine operation.

• Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of equipment design, operating principles, control systems, critical process parameters, and equipment performance requirements.

• Lead technical troubleshooting and root cause analysis for equipment failures, performance issues, and recurring technical problems, and support implementation of effective corrective actions.

• Drive equipment reliability, performance optimization, preventive maintenance improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with Manufacturing and Maintenance.

• Support product technology transfer and scale-up activities.

• As a member of the global engineering team, actively connect with and contribute to DP global engineering project planning and implementation.

Regulatory Compliance

• Ensure assigned equipment and engineering activities are executed in compliance with cGMP requirements, applicable regulatory expectations, and internal quality and engineering standards.

• Support regulatory inspections, customer audits, and internal audits by serving as an equipment SME.

• Partner with Quality Assurance to maintain validated state and continuous compliance of sterile manufacturing systems.

• Support contamination control strategy implementation and aseptic process simulation/media fill activities, as applicable.

• Act as the owner of equipment maintenance procedures, spare parts management strategy, and future equipment modifications or upgrades, and support maintenance of equipment in a qualified and controlled state.

• Support deviation investigations, CAPA implementation, change control assessments, and technical impact evaluations.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Technical Support

• Work closely with Operations and Technical Services teams to support equipment readiness, process implementation, technology transfer, and new product introduction activities.

• Partner with Validation and Quality to provide engineering expertise for qualification, validation, deviation investigations, and compliance-related activities.

• Support development and execution of operator and technical training.

• Act as a key technical interface between internal departments and equipment vendors to support efficient issue resolution and long-term equipment performance.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail and clarity.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related technical discipline.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

• Hands-on experience with pharmaceutical formulation systems, including powder handling, weighing and dispensing, solution preparation, mixing, sterile filtration, bulk solution transfer, and/or bulk holding systems.

• Experience with CIP/SIP systems and a strong understanding of pharmaceutical cleaning and sterilization principles.

• Experience with autoclaves, parts washers, or other pharmaceutical cleaning and sterilization equipment is strongly preferred.

• Deep understanding of cGMP requirements, risk-based approaches, and global regulatory expectations.

• Proven experience in start-up or expansion of manufacturing facilities is highly preferred.

• Strong knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), regulatory guidelines (FDA, EMA, ICH), and industry standards.

The anticipated base salary is:  $110k - $145k

title: Technical Services Engineer - OSD Equipment
description:

• Use equipment history, work-order trends, vendor recommendations, and risk/criticality assessments to identify recurring issues and improve preventive maintenance and equipment reliability.

• Support deviation investigations, CAPA, change control, risk assessments, audit/inspection responses, and technical impact assessments related to assigned manufacturing equipment.

• Work closely with Manufacturing to prioritize equipment issues and plan maintenance windows while protecting safety, product quality, schedule, and equipment reliability.

• Support creation and revision of maintenance SOPs, technical work instructions, troubleshooting guides, and equipment training materials and provide technical coaching as appropriate.

• Participate in continuous-improvement initiatives that improve equipment availability, maintainability, compliance, throughput, and total cost of ownership.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline with 3+ years of relevant pharmaceutical or regulated manufacturing-equipment experience; an equivalent combination of education and strong hands-on equipment maintenance/support experience may be considered.

• Demonstrated hands-on experience supporting, troubleshooting, maintaining, and repairing industrial or pharmaceutical manufacturing equipment.

• Understanding of cGMP equipment lifecycle requirements, maintenance documentation, change control, deviation/CAPA processes, and maintenance of equipment in a qualified/controlled state.

title: Principal Scientist / Associate Director - Peptide Medicinal Chemistry
description:
WuXi AppTec is a leading global Contract Research, Development, and Manufacturing Organization (CRDMO) providing integrated drug discovery and development services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies worldwide. Our peptide discovery group combines mRNA Display, Phage Display, Peptide DNA-Encoded Libraries (DEL), and peptide chemistry to discover and optimize novel macrocyclic peptide therapeutics.

We are seeking a highly motivated Principal Scientist / Associate Director - Peptide Medicinal Chemistry to join our global peptide discovery team. The candidate will lead the design and optimization of peptide and macrocyclic peptide hits and leads originating from WuXi AppTec's peptide discovery platforms.

The primary focus of this role is to translate screening hits into optimized lead compounds through SAR exploration and rational design. The ideal candidate will have a strong track record of establishing SAR and advancing initial peptide hits into lead compounds with improved potency and developability.

The candidate will work cross-functionally with teams including display scientists, peptide chemists, and groups supporting biochemical, cellular, ADME, and DMPK studies to integrate screening, pharmacology, and developability data into effective optimization strategies.

This role will connect peptide hit discovery with medicinal chemistry-driven lead optimization, enabling rapid progression from initial hits toward lead candidates. The level of the position will be determined based on the candidate's experience, scientific leadership, and demonstrated ability to lead peptide medicinal chemistry and lead optimization programs.

• Lead medicinal chemistry strategies for peptide and macrocyclic peptide hit-to-lead and lead optimization programs, serving as medicinal chemistry lead and providing scientific direction to multidisciplinary project teams.

• Work closely with display and DEL teams to translate screening hits into optimized lead series through rational design, analogue synthesis, and iterative SAR development.

• Develop SAR hypotheses and design analogues using sequence scanning, amino acid substitution, conformational constraint, and structure-guided approaches.

• Identify key binding determinants and optimize peptide sequences and chemical features to improve potency, selectivity, stability, permeability, solubility, and cellular activity.

• Integrate binding, kinetic, biophysical, structural, and functional data to guide analogue design and compound prioritization.

• Design peptides incorporating noncanonical amino acids and other chemical modifications to improve target engagement and developability.

• Design focused follow-up libraries and analogue series to efficiently explore chemical space around validated peptide scaffolds.

• Incorporate stability, permeability, physicochemical, PK/PD, and in vivo data into lead optimization and compound prioritization.

• Work closely with multidisciplinary teams to interpret enrichment and screening data, identify actionable SAR trends, and define optimization strategies that advance peptide discovery programs.

• Collaborate with peptide chemistry teams to prioritize synthesis and rapidly execute iterative optimization campaigns.

• Work with structural and computational scientists to incorporate structural information and modeling into peptide design where appropriate.

• Provide scientific leadership across multiple peptide discovery and lead optimization programs, setting medicinal chemistry strategies and priorities, guiding hit triage and lead prioritization, and identifying key scientific risks and opportunities.

• Provide scientific direction and mentorship to peptide medicinal chemistry scientists and contribute to the development of medicinal chemistry capabilities within the peptide discovery organization.

• Communicate SAR, experimental results, optimization strategies, and program recommendations to multidisciplinary project teams, senior scientific leadership, clients, and external collaborators as appropriate.

Education

• Ph.D. in Medicinal Chemistry, Peptide Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Chemical Biology, or a related discipline.

• Postdoctoral experience in peptide drug discovery or medicinal chemistry is desirable.

Required Experience

• 7+ years of relevant experience in peptide therapeutics, peptide medicinal chemistry, or drug discovery.

• Demonstrated success in progressing peptide or macrocyclic peptide programs through hit-to-lead and lead optimization.

• Strong track record of SAR exploration and translating initial screening hits into optimized lead compounds.

• Demonstrated ability to independently develop and execute medicinal chemistry strategies and make data-driven optimization decisions.

• Experience leading multidisciplinary drug discovery programs and working effectively across discovery functions.

• Experience mentoring scientists and providing scientific direction to project teams is desirable.

Technical Expertise

• Strong expertise in peptide medicinal chemistry and SAR-driven optimization.

• Strong understanding of peptide and macrocycle design.

• Experience with solid-phase peptide synthesis (SPPS), peptide characterization, LC-MS, and HPLC.

• Experience with noncanonical amino acids and/or chemically modified peptides is highly desirable.

• Understanding of peptide developability, including stability, permeability, solubility, and physicochemical properties.

• Familiarity with structural biology and computational approaches to peptide design is desirable.

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is particularly valuable:

• Macrocyclic peptide therapeutics

• mRNA Display

• Phage Display

• Peptide DNA-Encoded Libraries (DEL)

• Noncanonical amino acids and peptide backbone modification

• Structure-based peptide design

• Experience interpreting structural biology data (e.g., X-ray crystallography or cryo-EM) and applying structural insights to peptide design

• Peptide ADME and developability optimization

• Protein-protein interaction targets

• Intracellular peptide therapeutics

• Experience working with internal or external peptide chemistry resources

Communication & Collaboration

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to clearly communicate SAR, experimental results, optimization strategies, and program recommendations to multidisciplinary teams and senior scientific leadership.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across discovery functions.

locationsText: 6122 Nancy Ridge Dr, San Diego, CA (On-site)
description:
WuXi Biology-US is seeking a Project Management Associate to support the review and generation of quotations in response to client queries and coordinate the communications with clients. The ideal candidate will have a biology background, strong attention to detail, and excellent organizational skills. This role requires working collaboratively within a team and under supervision to ensure proposal deadlines are met.

• Review incoming client queries and work with technical team to generate accurate and timely quotations based on project requirements.

• Coordinate efficient and effective communication with the clients and stake holders.

• Maintain and update proposal records, ensuring all documentation is complete and accurate.

• Work closely with internal teams to gather necessary information for quotation development, contract establishment and project execution.

• Track and manage proposal timelines to ensure all deadlines are met.

• Ensure consistency, accuracy, and compliance with company standards in all quotations.

• Assist in refining quotation workflows to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Business, or a related field.

• Experience: Prior experience in project coordination, quotation generation, business development, or a related field is preferred.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:

• Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills in English. Fluent in Chinese is a preferred.

• Technical Skills: Strong administrative skills and proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook); familiarity with project management tools is an advantage.

• Soft Skills: Excellent interpersonal skills, strong analytical, organizational, and multi-task time-management abilities.

• Detail-Oriented: Ability to review and analyze complex data.

• Team Player: Works well within a structured team environment and under supervision.

Physical Requirements:

• Must be able to work in an onsite office environment.

• Ability to stand /sit/walk for long periods of time.

• Must be able to perform some activities with repetitive motion, such as keyboarding.

• Must be able to travel for long distances in various methods of transportation (e.g. car, airplane, shuttle bus, train, etc.)

• Must be able to navigate to and from site locations, hotel, and airports with personal luggage and laptop.

• Must be able to work in environment with variable noise levels.

Anticipated salary range: $56,535 to $73,796

An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability

This job description does not state or imply that the above are the only duties and responsibilities assigned to this position.  Employees holding this position will be required to perform any other job-related duties as requested by Management.
